address.heading: Where to join
address.addressHtml: Zoom link located in your Google Calendar invitation.

items: Find a quiet, private space with good lighting
Confirm the Zoom link is working — we recommend downloading the desktop application
Test your camera, microphone, speakers and internet connection ahead of time
Close extra tabs or applications to avoid notifications or lag

paragraphs.html: You will be automatically placed in a waiting room and will need to be admitted by the first interviewer. If you leave the session at any time, you will need to be admitted again.
The use of Zoom AI features or any personal recording, transcription, or automated note-taking tools during live interviews is not permitted.

cards.title: NDA
cards.body: Before your scheduled interview, please ensure that you electronically sign our NDA using Box Sign through the provided link.
cards.note: All candidates are required to sign in order to begin their interview. If you have any questions regarding the NDA form, please reach out to your Recruiting Coordinator.

contact.heading: Questions?
contact.body: Got a question we didn't cover? Reach out to your Recruiter and Recruiting Coordinator.
